Exact crop of the published Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side), PDF page 9: the slip of [[Jedi Advisor (V) (Errata 3)]] (official text as of 27 April 2013; PDF built February 2014). It prints errata version PC-E3 (“Never deploys, except to Coruscant. While Yoda here, Force retrieval from your [Virtual Block 5] objective cannot be canceled (except by Secret Plans). Unless Inner Strength on table, your duel destiny and lightsaber combat totals are cumulatively +1.”), word for word the text of [[Jedi Advisor (V)]]. The label under the slip reads “Alderaan Operative (V)”, as printed in the Master List.<ref>[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Master List (Light Side)]]. Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>
